description: Canadian Public Transit Network Database provides a national compilation of static GTFS schedules from 150 Canadian transit agencies with geospatial exports. The provider is Statistics Canada. Geographical and temporal coverage: Coverage is Canada; core fields include agencies, stops, routes, trips, stop times and service calendars. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The page establishes existence and purpose, but neither completeness nor fitness for a particular simulation was independently tested. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. data-statcan-canadian-cycling-pedestrian-network-databases mentions this companion collection, but its records and access links cover cycling and walking, not this transit release.
